description: The chart illustrates bias percentage values across three topical categories (Sports, a middle category whose x-axis label is obscured by a gray block, and Healthcare) for three conditions—No Contact, Positive Contact, and Negative Contact—each shown “Before” and “After.” The horizontal axis contains the categories in left-to-right order (Sports, obscured label, Healthcare) with no numeric scale, while the vertical axis is labeled “Bias Percentage” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals. Each category contains three vertical stacked bars: a solid base segment for “Before” and a hatched top segment for “After,” with colors indicating condition (gray for No Contact, pink/red for Positive Contact, and light blue/dark blue for Negative Contact). In Sports, the No Contact bar shows 45.42 (solid gray, Before) with an additional 7.45 (hatched gray, After) stacked on top; the Positive Contact bar shows 43.65 (solid pink, Before) plus 8.31 (hatched red, After); and the Negative Contact bar shows 50.05 (solid light blue, Before) plus 8.33 (hatched dark blue, After). In the middle (obscured) category, the No Contact bar shows 38.08 (Before) with 0.00 (After), the Positive Contact bar shows 35.38 (Before) with 0.01 (After), and the Negative Contact bar shows 40.79 (Before) with 0.00 (After). In Healthcare, the No Contact bar shows 40.70 (Before) with 0.00 (After), the Positive Contact bar shows 37.51 (Before) with 0.01 (After), and the Negative Contact bar shows 46.73 (Before) with 0.11 (After). Numeric labels are printed within the solid segments and above the hatched segments, and the bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by magnitude; no additional emphasis beyond color and hatching is used.
